display_long_description:
**Full Physics Interaction**

Every part of your body from head to toe is fully physics-based, even your fingers! Every object has been carefully crafted to maximize physics interaction and collision fidelity.

[media]

**10 Unique Maps, Many More to Come**

10 fun maps full of physics interactions, with many more to come in the near future!

[media]

**Physics-Based Flipping**

Do true physics-based flips using the ragdoll toggle and swinging your arms in the direction you want to flip. Any flip is possible from backflips, frontflips, sideflips, to even twists!

[media]

**Power-Ups**

Certain foods give you special power-ups like increased speed, jump power, strength, and more!

[media]
